sloka: वरदानात् पितृव्यस्ते सहते देवदानवान्।कुम्भकर्णस्तु वीर्येण सहते च सुरासुरान् ।। ६.७६.७६ ।।
transliteration: varadānāt pitṛvyaste sahate devadānavān।kumbhakarṇastu vīryeṇa sahate ca surāsurān ।। 6.76.76 ।।

translations.english: "Your uncle Ravana is able to withstand the Devas and Danavas by virtue of the boons and Kumbhakarna was able to with stand gods and demons by virtue of his courage."
